question: After the activation defect and proof gap are resolved, should guided setup automatically install and enable Codex supervision while retiring the separate shipped codex-supervisor plugin?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes plugin ownership, setup defaults, configuration shape, and operator capabilities; those are product and upgrade choices that the protected maintainer label leaves to an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Adopt the consolidated design
options.body: Keep supervision in the official Codex plugin, preserve the doctor migration and opt-out controls, and land after activation and proof gates pass.

options.title: Keep supervision separately opt-in
options.body: Retain consolidation but remove guided auto-enablement so users must explicitly enable the new supervision config after migration.

options.title: Retain the separate plugin
options.body: Pause this PR and preserve codex-supervisor as the independent product and configuration boundary.

recommendation.title: Adopt the consolidated design
recommendation.body: Keep supervision in the official Codex plugin, preserve the doctor migration and opt-out controls, and land after activation and proof gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main history and linked feature work make this person the strongest available owner for the intended Codex supervision product boundary.
